verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for an online government tax-services portal, since such services could expose programmatic access, so the axis applies. The evidence pack lists only UI-driven services (account login, online payment, forms, simulators, correcting declarations) and a 'Statistiques et Données' page. None of it documents a public API, let alone one matching what the UI can do.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
